name: menubar-34
description: Notifications menubar with closeOnClick disabled so several channel checkboxes can be toggled in one go.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Bell as BellIcon, Hash as HashIcon, Mail as MailIcon, MessageSquare as MessageSquareIcon, } from "@designali/icons" import { Menubar, MenubarCheckboxItem, MenubarContent, MenubarGroup, MenubarItem, MenubarLabel, MenubarMenu, MenubarTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/menubar" const channels = [ { id: "email", label: "Email", icon: MailIcon }, { id: "push", label: "Push", icon: BellIcon }, { id: "sms", label: "SMS", icon: MessageSquareIcon }, { id: "slack", label: "Team chat", icon: HashIcon }, ] export default function NotificationChannelsMenubar() { const [enabled, setEnabled] = React.useState>({ email: true, push: true, sms: false, slack: false, }) const active = channels.filter((c) => enabled[c.id]).map((c) => c.label) return (
Notifications Deliver via {channels.map((c) => ( setEnabled((s) => ({ ...s, [c.id]: checked })) } > {c.label} ))} Schedule Pause for 1 hour Quiet hours...

{active.length ? "Sending to " + active.join(", ") : "All channels are off"}

) }
